raw_prompt: !create add a skript that adds a command that spawns a villager named "Dylan". And when you attack him he sends a pathetic message in chat
reviewer_feedback: Added a command to spawn a villager named 'Dylan' who complains when attacked.
usage_instructions: Use /spawn-dylan to summon Dylan the villager.
Attack Dylan to hear his pathetic complaints in chat.

mutations.content:
command /spawn-dylan:
    permission: op
    trigger:
        spawn 1 villager at player
        set name of last spawned villager to "Dylan"
        send "Dylan has arrived." to player

on damage of entity:
    if name of victim is "Dylan":
        send "&cDylan: &7Please stop, that really hurts... why are you so mean?" to attacker

traces.intent_summary: Create a command to spawn a villager named Dylan who sends a chat message when damaged.

traces.rationale: Created a command to spawn a villager named 'Dylan' using standard Skript entity spawning. Used the 'on damage' event to check the entity's name and trigger a chat message to the attacker, ensuring the logic is scoped specifically to the target entity.
